metadata.description: General-purpose AI tooling by Michael Pesin: skills and agents usable in any codebase, by anyone

plugins.name: repo-mapper
plugins.description: Replace /init with a generated repo-guide skill: a small SKILL.md index (<=100 lines) plus on-demand references/, built by a verified multi-agent pipeline. Git is the only state store — no manifest, stamps, or checksums; staleness is derived and refresh is a full, cost-confirmed regeneration

plugins.name: design-critic
plugins.description: Adversarial DESIGN reviewer agent (not a general critical-thinking aid): attacks the assumptions of plans, specs, and architectures, hunts failure modes, steelmans simpler alternatives, returns severity-ranked findings and a verdict

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: PR review with memory: remembers its prior findings on a PR and converges instead of re-reporting, applies path-scoped REVIEW.md rules and records learnings, checks the diff against the PR's stated intent, and works the author side (address review comments with verification). Complements the built-in /code-review

plugins.name: decision-log
plugins.description: Per-repo, git-committed memory of crucial decisions and their reasoning, organized by domain: generates a project skill (.claude/skills/decisions/) with records that carry the decision, the rejected alternatives and the consequences; capture with approval gates, query by topic or path, lint for rot

plugins.name: worklog
plugins.description: Carry development work across sessions: one committed markdown file per work item (goal, immutable task list, decisions, append-only session log, next action) that a fresh session resumes ledger-first; commits found by task id in git, nothing derived from git is stored
